title: Lazy-Expiry Booking Service with Injected Clock
instructions: Implement `InMemorySeatRepository` and `BookingService` in `booking_service.py`. A soft-locked seat that is older than the hold window becomes claimable again, but the stored status is not rewritten until someone claims it. Do the check-and-act under the repository lock, validate every seat before mutating any, and drive everything from the injected clock.

evidence.label: Holding seats blocks them for the user and reports them BLOCKED
A hold lapses only when strictly older than the window (exactly 15 minutes is still held)
Stored status stays BLOCKED after expiry while availability reports AVAILABLE
A claim that includes one unavailable seat changes nothing
Unknown show or seat raises NotFoundError (also from availability and confirm) and mutates nothing
Confirm requires the holder, rejects unheld seats and raises HoldExpiredError after expiry
Rejects an empty label list and a naive clock; duplicate labels count once
Sixteen racing claims on an expired hold have exactly one winner
A BOOKED seat never expires or becomes claimable
Reclaiming an expired hold starts a fresh window
